description.narrative: (Philippines): .USAID, through the TB Innovations activity, will strengthen implementation of the Philippine Strategic TB Elimination Plan by supporting the Department of Health (DOH) to scale up high impact interventions designed to prevent, detect, and treat TB. These interventions will also strengthen the capacity of local partners. This activity contributes to the U.S. foreign policy priority to defend the U.S. from the spread of deadly infectious diseases and its interventions align with USAID's Global Accelerator to End TB...USAID will assist the DOH to reach the pre-COVID-19 performance level of the National Tuberculosis Control Program on key indicators, including TB notification. USAID will implement the integrated testing approach to detect COVID-19 and TB and continue to support the "screen all" approach for all patients visiting health facilities. USAID will help expand a network of laboratories and optimize capacities of diagnostic facilities to provide comprehensive and high-quality TB diagnostic services, including use of chest X-rays as a screening tool and scale up of rapid diagnostic tests as a primary diagnostic tool. USAID will support the adoption and scale up of new tools, including use of ultra portable X-rays and Truenat for TB testing. USAID will support adoption and scale up of digital adherence tools to improve treatment compliance. FY 2022 funds will also support the modeling of integrated local health systems under the Universal Health Care law framework, including the provision of primary care packages, establishment of health care provider networks, advancement in cooperative and transparent governance, and development of efficient pooling of resources. USAID will also strengthen the National Coordinating Committee to oversee progress and ensure achievement of targets, engage the private sector to improve its capacity and access to affordable diagnostic equipment and supplies, and institutionalize policies to reduce TB transmission...

title.narrative: TB Platforms for Sustainable Detection, Care and Treatment (TB Platforms)

description.narrative: (Philippines): USAID, through the TB Platforms activity, will strengthen and sustain supportive interventions to increase case detection of TB and drug-resistant TB (DR-TB) and improve treatment success rates. It advances the U.S. government's Global TB Strategy, USAID's Global Accelerator to End TB, and the U.S. priority to defend the U.S. against the spread of deadly infectious diseases. .USAID will support local governments and communities to adapt and recover from the reduction in TB and DR-TB service provision due to COVID-19 by assisting the Department of Health National TB Control Program's Adaptive Plan to COVID-19 and the TB Recovery Plan. USAID will support health providers to adopt high-impact case-finding approaches, contact investigation, and the FAST ("finding cases actively, separating safely, treating effectively") Plus strategy. USAID will increase demand for TB services through social and behavior change activities that: reduce stigma; deploy facility-level quality improvement teams to roll out patient-centered interventions; integrate TB diagnosis and treatment as part of hospital-wide approaches to infection control and case finding; assist local government units (LGUs) to establish more responsive TB strategies in post-disaster environments; analyze local TB data to identify hotspot areas and risk groups; and support adoption and scale up of digital adherence tools to improve treatment compliance...USAID's COVID-19 mitigation interventions ensure continuity of TB services and include strengthening human resources for health at the LGU level to improve TB testing, expand community outreach, including contact investigation and the use of virtual platforms, set up TB contact centers, and integrate TB screening and detection in COVID-19 response..To support the integration of local health systems, USAID will help establish the Health Care Provider Network, the platform for integrated service delivery, in selected sites.

(Philippines): .USAID, through the YouthWorksPH activity, supports workforce development for youth ages 15-29 who are not in education, employment, or training by mobilizing local private sector resources to provide innovative and work-based training opportunities, and leveraging $4 from local partners for every $1 USAID invests in the program. ..Using higher education-earmarked resources, USAID will expand support to trainees and partner institutions to provide quality and relevant training to increase youth employment, in spite of the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and the challenges of virtual learning. USAID targets at least 1,500 youth to be recruited, trained, and deployed for on-the-job training, and/or placed in work opportunities, especially in growing industries. In addition, USAID aims to support at least one recognized industry body, sector skills council, localized government/industry/academic council, or industry association. USAID will also support the Workforce Development Summit to increase cooperation among key stakeholders in this sector. .Finally, USAID will help establish the learner management information system by providing technical assistance to the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority, the Department of Trade and Industry, and the Department of Labor and Employment. USAID will assist in creating an application programming interface for a synchronized database on private sector-led training...

description.narrative: (Philippines): .With Family Planning-earmarked funds, USAID, through the ReachHealth activity, engages and collaborates with national partners like the DOH, Commission on Population (POPCOM), Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth), Department of Education (DepEd), and local government units...USAID will support Universal Health Care (UHC) implementation and the health system's full devolution and institutionalization of UHC funding for Family Planning (FP), referral mechanisms, and accessible information systems, and strengthening community participation and private sector engagement. USAID will scale up high-impact interventions to increase FP users, sustain current users, and contribute to the reduction of teen pregnancies. ..USAID will institutionalize high-impact social and behavior change initiatives, improve the FP training system, increase community health worker retention within a primary care provider network, expand social health insurance coverage, strengthen local health boards, and continue support to introduce new FP commodities in the market...USAID will document locally-led innovative approaches and fortify responsive partnerships. USAID will support POPCOM and DepEd to scale-up and institutionalize educational and service delivery platforms that impact adolescent and youth development, and address some of the underlying causes of teenage pregnancy, including child marriage, gender-based violence, and coercion, and take a comprehensive approach to preventing and delaying a follow-on pregnancy among teens...USAID will support the integration of local health systems in selected sites by fostering cooperative and transparent governance, establishing and strengthening health care provider networks, and boosting financing mechanisms to promote sustainability....

Build DOH capacity for public financial management and for rationalizing provision of technical and financial support to priority provinces and cities. This includes support for the development of performance-based grants and the multi-year investment plan for health. Help PhilHealth implement the Benefit Development Plan to rationalize the process of introducing and rolling out benefits and develop a monitoring system for the financial viability of the National Health Insurance Program, including the provision of benefits. Assist the enhancement and optimization of Benefit Packages for tuberculosis, family planning, and HIV. Support the DOH and PhilHealth in developing a financing and governance model for UHC implementation in selected UHC integration sites to demonstrate a functional Special Health Fund that optimizes financial resources for service delivery. title.narrative: Regulatory Reform Support Program for National Development (RESPOND)

description.narrative: (Philippines): The RESPOND activity advances the administration's vision for a free and open Indo-Pacific in particular through its contribution to the Trade and Investment initiative under the economic pillar. RESPOND seeks to improve regulatory quality that will lead to greater market access, more competition, lower transactions costs and, ultimately, higher levels of trade and investment. RESPOND seeks to enhance market competition and strengthen regulatory capacity and governance. To advance market competition, RESPOND will support Philippine efforts to reduce barriers to entry, regulatory burdens, and transaction costs for business. To strengthen the capacity of regulatory institutions, it will seek to improve regulatory oversight and strengthen transparency and accountability mechanisms. RESPOND will support the implementation of the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act through technical assistance to improve the capacity of the Anti-Red Tape Authority (ARTA), a newly formed unit under the Office of the President. RESPOND will support ARTA develop its Philippine Business Regulations Information System and its Anti-Red Tape Enterprise Management Information System to advance regulatory transparency. It will also build ARTA's capacity to conduct regulatory impact analysis and set up a regulatory management system. RESPOND will help enhance the capacity of the Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) to act against anti-competitive practices. It will assist the PCC identify industries and sectors for competition enforcement and advance a competition policy framework for government entities. It will support the Government Commission on Government Owned Corporations to advance its public enterprise reform agenda. Finally, RESPOND will support the Department of Information and Communication to implement Digital Philippines, particularly on the establishment of a central business portal.. .. .

description.narrative: (Philippines): .USAID, through the Gabay (Guide) Strengthening Inclusive Education activity, improves access of deaf, blind, or deafblind children to quality education. USAID will increase the capacity of general education teachers to teach children with disabilities, strengthen local capacity to develop more special education teachers, and increase parents'/caregivers' capacity to support sign language and Braille reading. Funds will support the objectives of the Domestic Resource Mobilization initiative in the Philippines through tax policy and administration reforms that will broaden the country's tax base, increase collection, and implement business process re-engineering activities. description.narrative: (Philippines): .Be Secure increases sustainable access to water supply/sanitation services and resilience to climate change impacts and supports USAID's Climate Change and Development Strategy and Water and Development Strategy. It works with the Philippine government to advance water sector reform, increase access to water/sanitation financing, and institutionalize climate change considerations in the water and planning sectors. It uses an integrated approach at national and local levels. Wastewater management will be addressed through national-level policy assistance and support to local governments and water districts. Approximately $1,774,184 in FY 2016 direct GCC-Adaptation funds will improve the Philippines' capacity to analyze, communicate, and use climate data. Down-scaled climate projections and updated hazard maps will be integrated into local planning. Be Secure will build capacity for water demand management. Typhoon Haiyan assistance will continue to rehabilitate water supply systems..

(Philippines): .The five-year Philippine-American Fund Grant Facility promotes sustainable development by competitively awarding grants to local organizations to sponsor activities in five broad categories - economic growth, governance, counter-trafficking, education and biodiversity conservation. The economic growth grants fund enterprise development and jobs generation. The governance grants strengthen the work of civil society organizations in promoting public sector accountability and transparency. The counter-trafficking grants assist local partners in improving trafficking prevention and prosecution and victim protection. The education grants finance scalable and technology-based solutions for quality education in hard-to-reach areas. The biodiversity grants foster conservation and management of natural resources to improve environmental resilience. USAID has awarded grants to 26 local organizations to date, and anticipates the award of 12 more in FY 2016..

The Phil-Am Fund Project will issue sub-grants that support inclusive, sustainable growth by contributing to five broad categories: 1) enterprise development, 2) governance, 3) counter trafficking in persons, 4) education innovation challenge grants, and 5) biodiversity conservation.

description.narrative: (Philippines): This activity will support select Philippine national government agencies in driving growth in electronic payments through policy reforms, business process improvements, and capacity building. The activity will focus on key areas where volume of payment transactions is high, including in government disbursements and revenue collections, at both the national and local government levels. E-PESO will support the Department of Budget and Management and the Bureau of the Treasury to shift national government disbursements from the current system using only government authorized depository banks, to PESONet, a U.S.-supported electronic payment initiative. PESONet makes payments to suppliers and contractors possible, whether or not the supplier's/contractor's bank is a government depository bank. U.S. assistance will also support agencies with large payment streams involved in the delivery of critical public services to shift to electronic payments. This will help increase transparency, reduce spending leakages, and enhance the efficiency in disbursements for public infrastructure, public services, and social support funds. E-PESO will also help improve efficiency of government collections, including support for the Bureau of Internal Revenue to expand options for revenue collection. It will provide advice to the Philippine central bank and the payment industry to establish more electronic payment channels to accelerate the shift towards electronic payments in retail transactions.Together, these different improvements will increase government resources for spending priorities, while improving the ease of doing business. Overall, the shift towards digital and electronic payments in retail transactions will increase domestic consumption and economic activities, and hence, economic growth. Planned activities will contribute to the U.S. foreign policy priorities of greater self-reliance and promoting a rules-based and transparent environment.... .

Objectives for Philippines: OBJECTIVES: Drive transaction volume. Support the expansion and effective management of e-payment infrastructures. Improve the enabling environment for e-payment usage; and,. Build the e-payment ecosystem with particular focus on key cities identified under USAID’s Cities Development Initiative
